'''Krevan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] of the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was found on the outskirts of the [[Lower Wilds]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] where he was working for his master, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Varacen]].
